main_goal: Sequentially evaluate multiple STT models/profiles on one live microphone stream with a continuous global timeline and precise timestamped metadata for quality-latency-hardware comparison.
in_scope: Sequential runner on one stream: run_i stop then run_i+1 start
Dual output: human transcript plus machine event log
Comparison table export without manual cleanup
out_of_scope: Presenting simulation output as online stream output
Long-file transcript batch orchestration handled by v6

phases.title: Backend sequential orchestrator on single live stream
deliverables: State machine for sequential model/profile switching

phases.title: Dual output time consistency
deliverables: Machine event log from same timeline
Consistency checks between transcript and events

phases.title: KPI computation and unified comparison table
Validation run with 3-5 models
deliverables: One real online scenario with 3-5 models

definition_of_done: Single online run contains multiple models sequentially without time reset
Every state transition has auditable event metadata
Transcript and event log are time-consistent
KPI table is exportable and comparable without manual intervention
Latency does not exceed hard limit 12 seconds and ideally stays in 5-8 seconds
